mapper.select: SELECT friendship_id, user_id, friend_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM friendship WHERE (user_id = #{a} AND friend_id = #{b}) OR (user_id = #{b} AND friend_id = #{a})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendship (user_id, friend_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE friendship SET user_id = #{userId}, friend_id = #{friendId}, status = 'REQUESTED' WHERE friendship_id = #{friendshipId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.friendship_id, u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image, f.created_at FROM friendship f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.birth_date, u.profile_image FROM friendship f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END WHERE (f.user_id = #{userId} OR f.friend_id = #{userId}) AND f.status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY u.nickname
